title: After the honour-guard fight, three companions were left critically wounded (Vell 1/9 hp, Brother Osk 2/8 hp, Lys 4/10 hp) with no way found to heal them; 'use dried herbs' and 'use wild herbs' only restore the player's own hp ('(hp+3)' applied to me alone), and no rest option existed in the crypts.
where: Marrowgate / The Old Crypts, honour guard fight
